summary: Reviewed all seven committed scripts/records in notes/jf_historical_batch_20261109 plus README, validation.json, tests.log, jobs.txt, submission.txt, status.json and the byte/SHA-indexed native evidence under build/history-review-evidence. The implementation matches scope: one SMD0/EB/BD trio, one GPU/one execution stream, 8 KvikIO workers, 1 MiB tasks, 16 MiB bounce, compat ON, auto direct I/O OFF, 6 GiB budget, PS_SMD_N_EVENTS=1000, raw bulk 1 MiB / sim10 512 KiB, NUMA interleave, shared physical-core affinity, owner-scoped FADV_DONTNEED cold gate after DataSource setup, physical NIC bracket with separate idle sample, no calibration, no user kernels, no timed D2H. Recomputed from native case JSON: all six full cases have 10,000 events, 50,000 requests, exact payload bytes (335,571,760,000 raw / 33,582,000,000 sim10), zero cpu_reads and pressure_drains, drained manager state, single stream pointer per case, callbacks 500x20 or 100x100, peak outstanding 640.05/64.05/320.26 MiB, initial residency 0 for all five files, final residency 94.35% (00) and ~100% elsewhere, NIC RX 343.96/33.60/34.10/33.75/33.36/339.17 GiB, rates 4.6835/1.9389/2.1203/2.1071/1.9855/4.7684 GiB/s, mean sim10 b100 vs b20 +7.7% and 42.3% of 5 GiB/s. Preflight raw pixel digests equal pixels.json for all three timestamps; runtime module hashes and B-install paths identical across cases; both mounts drpsrcf/ffb; cleanup removed the temporary sim10 copy; Slurm job 44003240 COMPLETED 0:0 in 13m05s with empty stderr. README limitations (server cache uncontrolled, different sources/gather forms, NIC bytes not an exact cache fraction, lazy allocations inside loop) are consistent with the code. Two non-blocking record corrections remain: README idle RX range should read 0.91–1.00 MiB/s for measured cases (05-raw idle is 0.9116 MiB/s, 02-sim10 is 1.0000), and status.json still says hardware-running. No blocking findings.

findings.evidence: README states 'idle RX about0.94–1.01MiB/s'. Native idle deltas: 05-raw-dense-b20 rx_bytes 2,094,006 over 2.1906 s = 0.9116 MiB/s; 02-sim10-field-b100 2,239,428 over 2.1357 s = 1.0000 MiB/s; 04 = 0.941, 00 = 0.954, 03 = 0.976, 01 = 0.977 MiB/s. Preflights are 0.998 and 1.049 MiB/s, so neither the measured-case nor the all-case range matches 0.94–1.01.
findings.requested_change: Correct the idle RX range to 0.91–1.00 MiB/s for the six measured cases (or 0.91–1.05 MiB/s if preflights are included, stated explicitly).

findings.evidence: status.json records phase 'hardware-running' and review_round 0 while jobs.txt shows job 44003240 COMPLETED 0:0 and README/validation.json record final results.
findings.requested_change: Update status.json to the completed/reviewed phase and review round when this review is recorded, as already planned.

findings.evidence: tests.log contains only the unittest summary ('Ran 11 tests in 0.349s / OK'); test_audit.py takes the evidence directory from sys.argv[1] but the invocation and directory are not recorded in the log or README.
findings.requested_change: Optional: record the test command and the evidence root used (native artifact path or build/history-review-evidence/native) alongside the tests.log output.

findings.evidence: Native affinity lists for all ranks contain 56 CPUs (0-31, 40-63) and numactl --show reports cpubind nodes 0 1 2 3 5 6 7; NUMA node 4 cores were not available to the job. README says 'All MPI ranks share all available physical cores', which is accurate but does not state the count.
findings.requested_change: Optional: note that the shared set was 56 physical cores (NUMA node 4 excluded by the allocation) so future comparisons against runs with 64 cores are not misread.

findings.evidence: The cold gate evicts and measures only info['files'] (the five BD payload streams). The smalldata SMD files read by SMD0 and the raw run's SMD files are not evicted or measured; README line 60 says 'zero resident pages for every file after DataSource setup'.
findings.requested_change: Optional: qualify the README statement to 'every payload (BD) file'; SMD traffic is small relative to payload and is already included in NIC bytes.
